purpose: Compare one selected vehicle across two independently selected trailing-day windows.
primaryGoal: Understand six period totals, semantic percentage changes and deterministic insights, with optional gated AI explanation.

dataSources.ownership: Backend periodstats aggregate; independent A/B query keys ['period-stats', vehicleId, days]; AbortSignal forwarded; disabled without a vehicle.
dataSources.knownContract: Current response is explicitly km, kWh, Wh/km and kg, not fully SI-canonical wire values. DB columns are distance_m and total_energy_added_wh. No completeness metadata; days=0 means all time. Do not guess or silently reinterpret units.

dataSources.ownership: Vehicle catalog supports banner visibility and the conditional fallback selector. Current route delegates vehicle selection to the workspace header.

dataSources.owner: AI guard and period-comparison narration handler
dataSources.ownership: Explicit user action only; vehicle_id/days_a/days_b operands and vehicle/window scopeKey; off-mode feature gate; never replaces deterministic comparison.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Six metric labels, endpoint-unit assumptions and display conversions recur in metrics, briefMetrics and PeriodSources rows.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse a typed page-domain metric descriptor/operand adapter without moving queries or calculations into shared presentation. Keep null/zero, source units and independent A/B behavior.

responsive.existingStrategy: Controls wrap and are full width below sm; one CardGrid; source summaries use measured placement width >=640; chart has 320/280 heights. No viewport rendered.

findings.detail: Details table hides Period A and Period B below md through mobileColumns. This caller supplies neither mobilePresentation nor expandable detail access and disables columnVisibility. DataTable applies hidden md:table-cell, so this table's baseline columns are unavailable on small screens, even though summary context retains measurements elsewhere.
findings.fix: Use the existing opt-in mobilePresentation with all five fields, or preserve all columns in a contained horizontal scroller. Do not remove baseline information to reduce width.

requiredRuntimeCoverage: chart actions and summary drawer open

accessibility.positiveEvidence: A/B selects and refresh have localized accessible names; decorative icons hidden; change arrows have spoken direction; chart supplies ariaLabel and dataColumns; source sections use associated headings.

findings.detail: DataTable receives tableId but no localized caption/name. Its native caption and aria-label fall back to the implementation identifier analytics:period-compare instead of Comparison details.
findings.fix: Pass a translated caption while preserving tableId persistence identity.

states.initialLoading: comparisonState requires a pair; skeletons render for dependent outputs; successful neighbor remains visible through PeriodSources.
states.empty: No selection shows a selection explanation; legitimate zero payloads remain numbers; no baseline chart is explained. The endpoint returns aggregate zeros for no rows and does not distinguish no observations from complete measured totals.
states.initialError: Missing operand's fatal error suppresses dependent comparisons, not the independently available source. Per-source retry and global refresh exist.
states.refreshError: Retained A/B payloads survive refresh errors; page dataSources and summary status expose degraded trust.
states.offline: Paused queries retain operands; absent offline source displays waiting-for-connection explanation. Actual offline behavior unverified.
states.partialUnknown: Source-level absence is preserved, but field-level nulls are coerced to zero in paired metrics; confidence is defensive because current backend always emits numeric fields.

findings.detail: When both objects exist, metric construction uses ??0 for every measurement and insights repeat the fallback. PeriodSources instead displays a dash for missing fields. A malformed/partial successful payload could become fabricated totals and favorable deltas. Current typed/server contract does not advertise nullable fields, so no present runtime failure is asserted.
findings.fix: Use known finite operands and missing reasons consistently; calculate each delta only when both corresponding measurements are known. Do not change legitimate server zero totals into unknowns without completeness evidence.

states.tests: Existing comparisonState and page modernization tests were inspected, NOTRUN. Mocks and historical tests are not current runtime acceptance.

visualIssues.detail: Positive/negative change body text uses fixed emerald-300/rose-300 rather than theme-resolved semantic text. Bar palette is local hard-coded hexes; contrast across light/custom/forced-color modes is unmeasured.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing semantic text/chart tokens with restrained severity colors. Preserve neutral metrics and user-selected chart/theme preferences; measure composed contrast.

visualIssues.detail: Comparison details formats all measurements as bare numbers; neither row labels nor Period A/B/change cells identify distance, energy, efficiency, cost or mass units. Summary includes units, but standalone table/export interpretation is ambiguous.
visualIssues.fix: Carry unit metadata into ComparisonRow and show units in accessible cells or metric labels; preserve numeric sort operands and truthful exported raw/display values.

visualIssues.detail: Distance/cost insight prose combines signed pctChange output with less/lower wording (for A<B, '-50% less'); zero movement chooses more/higher because pctChange.positive includes equality. Efficiency already uses unsigned magnitude and explicit unchanged handling.
visualIssues.fix: Use unsigned localized magnitude for directional sentences and a no-change sentence at equality, retaining signed percentages in table/chart contexts.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature imports LayoutCard from the internal layout-reference entry rather than the canonical layout category barrel; PeriodSources does the same for useCardPlacement.
architectureIssues.fix: Consume the existing category export where available; if useCardPlacement is intentionally internal, have the shared owner confirm the supported consumer API rather than page-editing a barrel.

architectureIssues.detail: Energy used is actually summed charging energy added; avg efficiency is charging energy divided by completed-drive distance; CO2 saved is a fixed distance*0.120 estimate. Labels/insights can imply measured driving consumption and measured emissions savings. Current response also converts SI DB values to rounded km/kWh wire values despite SI-only target contract.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must resolve the canonical endpoint/AI contract and provenance terminology in one coordinated change. Page owner should explain current added-energy and inferred-efficiency/CO2 semantics, without inventing measured drive consumption or independently converting the wire shape.

P1: Truthful energy/efficiency/CO2 provenance and coordinated SI endpoint contract

dataBehavior: Keep independent 7/30/90/365/all-time A/B windows, defaults 30 and 90 and URL state. They are business comparison ranges, not duplicate workspace range selectors.
Workspace route scope exposes vehicle and does not expose global range for /period-compare. Do not register this page to replace independent windows with one header range.
Keep raw cache payloads/query keys/AbortSignal/enablement/inherited retry policy.
Retain every usable source on refresh failure; missing operands are never fabricated.
Preserve zero-baseline neutral dashes and chart omission explanation, neutral distance/drives and lower-better energy/efficiency/cost.
Keep current endpoint units until an authorized coordinated SI integration; display distance preference and number precision/locale without cache mutation.
Keep banner persistence, single-vehicle suppression, optional AI gate/scope cancellation and deterministic content.
No source changes, server requests, narration requests or production mutations performed.
